children: Infosys Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:INFY) reported Q2 with $5.145B revenue, ~21% margin and $540M AI revenue but cut FY27 growth to 1–2% amid softer demand, pricing pressure and immigration headwinds; a large ~$5.2B TCV seven‑year deal contrasts with cautious analyst views.
Previous Week Recap
INFY Q2 Revenue And Margin
: INFY Q2 revenue $5.145B, net profit ₹7,823 crore, operating margin ~21%. AI revenue $540M (10.5%). Large deal TCV ~$5.2B with >$2B seven-year contract. FY27 revenue growth guide cut to 1–2%.
_INFOSYS Cuts FY27 Guidance_
: Infosys (INFY) cut FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1–2% CC from 1.5–3.0% and now projects CQGR of -1.0% to +0.3% for Q3–Q4, citing weaker H1 and soft Hi‑tech/ Retail demand
US PERM Suspension Impacts INFY
: U.S. suspended new and pending PERM labor certifications affecting Infosys Limited Sponsored ADR (INFY). Infosys says suspension unlikely to be material; separate DOJ immigration probe is ongoing.
INFY Q2FY27 Revenue Up
: Infosys ADR (INFY) posted Q2FY27 revenue up 1.2% sequentially and 1.5% year-over-year in constant currency, per the company's quarterly results.
US Immigration Bills affect INFY
: Proposed U.S. immigration bills (H-1B Modernisation, H-1B Fraud Crackdown, SMARTER) could affect Infosys Limited Sponsored ADR (INFY) by changing H‑1B rules and green‑card paths for its employees.
ICICI Cuts INFY Target
: ICICI Securities cut INFY target and kept REDUCE, citing muted FY27 organic revenue outlook, softer volumes, pricing pressure, strong TCV and net new deals, and a large seven‑year mega deal.
INFY Pricing Pressure, AI
: INFY CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka said pricing is under pressure from tougher competition and higher AI-related client expectations; volumes are softer and pricing gains are limited despite AI demand.
INFY Forward P/E Low
: Infosys ADR (INFY) shows a forward P/E of 15, below the sector median of 21 and under its five‑year average forward P/E of 21, indicating a relatively lower valuation.
Motilal Oswal Keeps BUY
: Motilal Oswal kept BUY on Infosys (INFY) with INR 1,300 target. 2QFY27: revenue USD 5.1B (+1.2% QoQ), EBIT margin 21%, PAT INR 78B. Watch AI revenue, deal conversion, pricing.
INFY SAP S/4HANA Deployment
: INFY deployed global SAP S/4HANA for Syngenta Crop Protection, unifying ERP across 80 countries and 10,000+ users, using Infosys Topaz, Cobalt cloud, automation, and standardized data processes.
